recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is indicated for FHIR-24678 unless PA later decides to change the substantive Patient $match algorithm guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-24678 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5 asking the Patient $match operation to remind implementers to consider excluding inactive patients, especially patients made inactive by merges, without mandating that behavior for every MPI algorithm.
initial_application: No prior AutoFHIR reconciliation commit for FHIR-24678 existed on the combined branch. Source history shows the requested wording was added by 7d0c697900482e293de8862ea9888a6c76a5aa81 and then editorially adjusted by 13532980956ad68750ef4cdd7e7138604ad267d9, both explicitly titled for FHIR-24678 and both changing source/patient/operationdefinition-Patient-match.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Patient as an active resource and assigns it to PA, making the inspected Patient operation source in current build scope. Later Patient $match commits for FHIR-39400, FHIR-37361, and FHIR-40880 changed other response or parameter text but left the inactive-patient guidance intact. PA 2020 Feb WGM minutes record the same Persuasive 8-0-0 FHIR-24678 decision. No Zulip hits were found for the issue key or inactive-patient merge terms.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because source/patient/operationdefinition-Patient-match.xml already contains the approved guidance, and duplicating it into the Patient narrative page would be redundant because that page links to the formal operation definition.
